initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault because qualifying demand record n06-r06 was silently omitted before the downstream job. The top-level corpus includes n06-r06 with demand_score 5, so it qualifies under the stipulated demand selection rule and should have been preserved in both handoffs. Job 2 received only seven needs and evidence_sources, missing n06-r06, so the downstream output could not include or rank it. The supplied upstream source localizes the omission to normalize: its allowed_record_ids list contains n06-r09 instead of n06-r06, then filters retained_df by that list.
